_note: Monument is a fictional agency. Streets are real, house numbers and all listing details are invented demo data. Prices are realistic estimates for Dublin in 2026. Photos live in src/assets/photos/ with these exact file names.

photos.alt: Red-brick Victorian terrace with a red front door and bay window
Front living room with a marble fireplace and bay window
Kitchen extension opening onto a walled garden

description: A red-brick Victorian terrace on a quiet, tree-lined avenue, three minutes from the Beechwood Luas stop. The front room keeps its marble fireplace, cornicing and bay window; the back of the house opens into a kitchen extension and a walled garden facing west.
Upstairs there are three bedrooms and a family bathroom, with a shower room on the return. The roof and windows were replaced in 2019; heating is gas.

photos.alt: Converted grey mews house with a glazed entrance on a cobbled lane
Open-plan living and kitchen with exposed brick and a skylight
Bedroom under a sloped ceiling with a roof window

description: A converted mews on a cobbled lane behind Chelmsford Road, two minutes from Ranelagh village. The ground floor is one open room with a polished concrete floor, an exposed brick wall and a skylight over the dining table.
Two bedrooms upstairs, each with its own shower room. Available furnished from 1 November on a 12-month lease.

photos.alt: Victorian red-brick house with granite steps and a green front door
Double reception room with two fireplaces and a piano
Long rear garden with a lawn and a garden studio

description: A Victorian house on three floors over a garden level, with granite steps up to the hall door. The double reception room keeps both marble fireplaces and its folding doors; the ceilings on the hall floor are 3.6 metres high.
The garden level has a family kitchen opening onto a 30-metre garden with an apple tree and a timber studio at the end. The house needs some updating, which is reflected in its energy rating.

photos.alt: Three-storey Victorian red-brick building with a shop at street level
Living room with a tall sash window and a fireplace
Galley kitchen with white tiles and a wooden worktop

description: A one-bedroom apartment on the second floor of a Victorian building on Rathmines Road Lower, a short walk from the canal and the Charlemont Luas stop.
The living room has a tall sash window and the original fireplace; the galley kitchen looks over the rooftops. Unfurnished, available now.
features: Walk to the canal and Luas

photos.alt: Edwardian red-brick semi-detached house with a gravel drive
Drawing room with a bay window and a tiled Edwardian fireplace
Kitchen and family room opening to a large garden

description: An Edwardian semi-detached house facing Herbert Park, with a gravel drive for two cars. The drawing room has a two-storey bay window and its tiled fireplace; the herringbone oak floors run through the hall floor.
At the back, a kitchen and family room with steel-framed glazing opens to a stone terrace and a large garden. Five bedrooms over two floors.

photos.alt: Five-storey pale brick apartment building with recessed balconies
Living area with floor-to-ceiling windows to a balcony
Balcony with two chairs overlooking the trees of Ballsbridge

description: A two-bedroom apartment on the fourth floor of a 2021 building on Lansdowne Road, four minutes from the DART. Floor-to-ceiling windows open onto a south-west balcony above the treetops.
Both bedrooms have their own bathroom. One parking space and a storage unit in the basement are included.

photos.alt: Off-white Victorian house on Clontarf Road facing Dublin Bay
Living room with a bay window seat looking at the sea
Bedroom with a sash window and a view of the bay

description: A Victorian house across the road from the promenade, with Dublin Bay in the front windows. The living room has a bay window with a seat, and the main bedroom upstairs looks straight out to sea.
Four bedrooms, a kitchen and dining room to the rear and a south-facing back garden. The seafront path to Bull Island starts at the door.
features: Sea views from the front rooms
Five minutes to Clontarf Road DART

photos.alt: 1930s pebble-dash semi-detached house with a curved bay window
Bright living room with a curved bay window and a tiled fireplace
Rear garden with a lawn, a shed and a patio table

description: A 1930s semi-detached family house on Kincora Road, with a curved bay window and a front garden with a drive. The living room and dining room run front to back; the kitchen was renovated in 2022.
Three bedrooms upstairs and a garden of about 20 metres with a timber shed. Schools, the seafront and Vernon Avenue are all within walking distance.

photos.alt: Single-storey red-brick artisan cottage with a navy front door
Small living room with a cast-iron fireplace
Walled courtyard garden with brick paving and a bistro table

description: A red-brick artisan cottage on one of Stoneybatter's quiet cottage streets, two minutes from Manor Street. The front room has a cast-iron fireplace; the kitchen at the back opens onto a small walled courtyard.
Two bedrooms and a bathroom. The cottage is in good order but would suit an energy upgrade, which grants may help with.

photos.alt: Edwardian red-brick terrace with a mustard-yellow front door
Living room knocked through to a dining room with a fireplace
Kitchen extension with a roof light and a narrow garden

description: An Edwardian terrace on Oxmantown Road, five minutes from the North Circular Road gate of Phoenix Park. The living and dining rooms are knocked through, with a fireplace in the front room and glass doors to the garden at the back.
A small kitchen extension with a roof light, three bedrooms and a bathroom upstairs, and a shower room downstairs.

photos.alt: Modern apartment building on Hanover Quay seen across the water
Penthouse living room with full-height glazing to a terrace
Roof terrace with seating looking over the canal basin

description: A top-floor penthouse on Hanover Quay with a 40 m² terrace over the Grand Canal Dock basin and the Bord Gáis Energy Theatre. The living space has full-height glazing on two sides and an exposed concrete ceiling.
Three bedrooms, two bathrooms and two parking spaces. The DART is four minutes away on foot.

photos.alt: Brick apartment building with balconies along the canal
Living room with a glass door to a balcony over the water
Bedroom with a window over the canal and a desk

description: A two-bedroom apartment on the third floor of Gallery Quay, with a balcony over the canal. The living room and the main bedroom both face the water.
Furnished, with a desk in the second bedroom. Available from 15 November on a 12-month lease.
